channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Manu Ginobili | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Manu Ginobili from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Dylan Harper on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
Spurs Harper, on being compared to Manu Ginobili:

“I think that’s a fair comparison to say. I think it’s an accurate comparison. We’re both lefties, big guards. Yeah, I’ve had a lot of conversations with him, especially when I first got here. Me and him kind of talked a lot about the role of the team and what to do, things of that nature. I think he’s kind of, more than anyone for me, been that vet that’s been around the Spurs for a long time and kind of just giving me insight of what he’s been through.”

Dylan Harper on Manu Ginobili, Jun 2, 2026. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Dylan Harper on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
“More about just the game and the speed and just how he adapted to it from a FIBA standpoint to coming over here. What was his biggest changes being a player and being professional outside of basketball? What kept you locked in? Just all little things I think that every NBA player goes through. …“I’ve hung out with Ginobili every day since I’ve been here. I’m just picking his brain and just asking him questions. From past players to coaches, everyone is involved in it. Everyone comes back.”

Dylan Harper on Manu Ginobili, Jul 10, 2025. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Tony Parker, Manu Ginobili, Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Magic Johnson, Tim Duncan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar
item.description:
Thompson:

“That’s one of the greatest partnerships ever. You can compare it to peanut butter and jelly. They’re one of the greatest duos of all time. No question about it. They won four championships together. You have to win championships together to be compared to Scottie Pippen and Michael Jordan or to Magic Johnson and Kareem Abdul-Jabbar or Tim Duncan and Manu Ginobili and Tony Parker. They are definitely in that category or that conversation.”

Klay Thompson on Tony Parker, Manu Ginobili, Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Magic Johnson, Tim Duncan, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Nov 12, 2024. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
Popovich joked but continued in a more serious manner,

“I think it’s just competitive nature, and I think most of us here are the same way. The competition is just thrilling. The teaching is fun in a sense you get to see people grow on and off the court, and over time those guys become your friends to the point I might find myself listening to them more than they are listening to me. They are young, their minds are active. Manu Ginobili is the most curious individual I’ve ever met in my life. He didn’t go to college, but he’d be reading about black holes in space, and he’ll ask me about different books, and it’s keeping me rolling. That’s the fun part of it all.”

Gregg Popovich on Manu Ginobili, Aug 11, 2023. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Vincent Collet on Tony Parker, Manu Ginobili, Gregg Popovich
item.description:
Talking with Yann Ohnona from L'Equipe, Metropolitans 92 head coachVincent Collet, who coaches Victor Wembanyama both in the club and in the French national team, welcomed the draft lottery's result.

“It was the choice I was hoping for. San Antonio is a franchise that has built its legend with foreign players. We saw that in France with the prism of Tony Parker but there was also Manu Ginobili and others. I think Gregg Popovich can be the best mentor for him,”

Vincent Collet on Tony Parker, Manu Ginobili, Gregg Popovich, May 28, 2023. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Cory Joseph on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
“I’ve been in World Cups, been in championships as an NBA player and I always remember those talks that we’d have, me and Tony Parker, Manu Ginobili,”

Cory Joseph on Manu Ginobili, Aug 25, 2022. Source: Toronto Star.

item.title: Stephanie K. on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
He was looking ahead to a matchup with Manu Ginobili.

“He had this vision of moments. He knew that for us to win the gold medal we would have to beat Argentina … and he wanted to guard Ginobili. Believe me, he already had that figured out. It wasn’t just to set an example for the team. … So,we do play Argentina in the semis, and we’re beating them by 20 points and Ginobili gets hurt … and it becomes a six-point game, because now [Kobe’s] not interested anymore. That’s who he was,”

Stephanie K. on Manu Ginobili, Oct 18, 2020. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Tony Parker, Manu Ginobili, Tim Duncan
item.description:
Paul Garcia:Coach Pop on how Tim Duncan, Manu Ginobili, and Tony Parker would have handled the bubble had they been playing at this time:

“They would have done it just like every other player. So far the discipline of the players has been great. They would be fine.”

Gregg Popovich on Tony Parker, Manu Ginobili, Tim Duncan, Aug 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @PaulGarciaNBA.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Matt Bonner, Manu Ginobili
item.description:
Pop on Mani Ginobili’s retirement continued:

“We’d be talking on buses and airplanes. So you know that’s going to be gone. Once I realized he wasn’t going to play anymore, we’ve been talking with him about hanging around and being at practices every now and then like Timmy. We actually took him on our coaches retreat this past week. He spent time with us, trying to develop strategies for the season. So we want to keep him around as much as we can, just like Timmy. And Matt Bonner. But we don’t listen to Matt. We just tell him to do his jokes.”

Gregg Popovich on Matt Bonner, Manu Ginobili, Sep 24, 2018. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
Mike D'Antoni on Manu Ginobili who announced he's retiring:

“He was simply a winner. A sure first ballot Hall of Fame player. Remarkable person and player.”

Mike D'Antoni on Manu Ginobili, Aug 27, 2018. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Manu Ginobili, Tony Parker
item.description:
Alvin Gentry, on the Spurs' Tony Parker-infused bench:

“When he and Ginobili step on the court, it goes back to those Phoenix days and it’s a nightmare. I don’t care how old they are or how many years they’ve played.”

Alvin Gentry on Manu Ginobili, Tony Parker, Feb 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @JMcDonald_SAEN.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
Stevens on Manu Ginobili’s clutch shooting:

“I said before the game, ‘He’s one of the best players at the ends of quarters I’ve ever seen.’ Now I’m wishing I didn’t say it.”

Brad Stevens on Manu Ginobili, Dec 9, 2017. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
Jeff McDonald:Pop, on the play that produced Ginobili's game-winner vs. Boston:

“I didn’t plan that. I didn’t draw that play. Manu just drew it up in his head and he did it like he does.”

Gregg Popovich on Manu Ginobili, Dec 9, 2017. Source: Twitter @JMcDonald_SAEN.

item.title: Robert Horry on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
“Let me just say this: You got yours because, if Manu Ginobili would have did the things he was supposed to do, I would have had like 10 championships.”

Robert Horry on Manu Ginobili, Jun 5, 2017. Source: For The Win.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Curry on applauding Manu when he went to bench:

“I'm a Manu Ginobili fan... I tried to do my best to give him that moment.”

Stephen Curry on Manu Ginobili, May 23, 2017. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
Adam Lauridsen:Durant on Ginobili:

“You can just tell how much he loves the game of basketball.”

Kevin Durant on Manu Ginobili, May 21, 2017. Source: Twitter @GSWFastBreak.

item.title: Isaiah Thomas on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
Celtics'Isaiah Thomas on Manu:

“Ginobili is one of the best players to ever play the game. He'll probably be a Hall of Famer.”

Isaiah Thomas on Manu Ginobili, Feb 18, 2017. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: James Harden on Dwyane Wade, Manu Ginobili
item.description:
Sirius XM NBA:James Harden on how he developed his Eurostep:

“I'm a student of the game. I watched Manu Ginobili and Dwyane Wade.”

James Harden on Dwyane Wade, Manu Ginobili, Feb 17, 2017. Source: Twitter @SiriusXMNBA.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
Popovich said of the San Antonio’s personnel.

“Can I make Manu Ginobili non-competitive? Probably not. People are who they are. So I think trying to figure out what one might [need] in a program and what you think fits best for your culture or for your style of coaching is part of the equation when you bring guys in, whether it’s the draft or free agency.”

Gregg Popovich on Manu Ginobili, Feb 12, 2017. Source: Newsday.

item.title: Luis Scola on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
So it comes to no surprise that seeing Manu retire from Team Argentina moved Scola as he reflected on his friend.

“I think it was a little bit more emotional playing with him (Manu Ginobili) this summer,”

Luis Scola on Manu Ginobili, Jan 26, 2017. Source: news4sanantonio.com.

item.title: Bruce Bowen on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
Sirius XM NBA:Bruce Bowen on Manu Ginobili's international legacy:

“I've never played with anyone quite like him in terms of how his country receives him.”

Bruce Bowen on Manu Ginobili, Aug 22, 2016. Source: Twitter @SiriusXMNBA.

item.title: Sergio Hernandez on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
David Aldridge:Argentina Coach Sergio Hernandez on Ginobili's last game for the team:

“I've known him since he was a child. It's a difficult day for me.”

Sergio Hernandez on Manu Ginobili, Aug 17, 2016. Source: Twitter @daldridgetnt.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
On this new venture, Thompson isn't thinking about Bosh, but instead at someone who played the same position.

“Ilook at a guy like Manu Ginobili who came off the bench almost his entire career,”

Klay Thompson on Manu Ginobili, Jul 21, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Tim Duncan on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
Melissa Rohlin:Tim Duncan on Manu Ginobili:

“He’s defined us in a lot of ways. He’s the spark and excitement that we’ve had off the bench for a lot of years. He’s accepted a role, as a guy who could have been a starter elsewhere and probably deserved to be a starter. He accepted a role knowing it was probably best for our team. That selflessness as a teammate is what defines us as a team”

Tim Duncan on Manu Ginobili, Mar 25, 2016. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Tim Duncan on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
Melissa Rohlin:Tim Duncan on if he'll retire after this season if Manu Ginobili does:

“We’re going to make those decisions individually, not as a group. So, no.”

Tim Duncan on Manu Ginobili, Mar 25, 2016. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
Melissa Rohlin:Pop on Ginobili:

“He's not going to play in this back-to-back or anything, but his progress has been much quicker than we thought.”

Gregg Popovich on Manu Ginobili, Mar 1, 2016. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Tony Parker on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
Melissa Rohlin:Tony Parker on Ginobili:

“Everybody was saying like six weeks and maybe longer, and now it looks like he could be back next week.”

Tony Parker on Manu Ginobili, Mar 1, 2016. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Ettore Messina on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Ettore Messina on Manu Ginobili:

“He's slowly getting better. He switches off his phone most of the day, so it's difficult to reach him.”

Ettore Messina on Manu Ginobili, Feb 10, 2016. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: LaMarcus Aldridge on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:LaMarcus Aldridge on losing Manu Ginobili:

“I didn't understand how talented he was until I got on the team. He makes some plays very few guys can make. He makes some plays very few guys can make. His energy, IQ for making guys better, are hard to match.”

LaMarcus Aldridge on Manu Ginobili, Feb 5, 2016. Source: Twitter.

item.title: LaMarcus Aldridge on Manu Ginobili
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:LaMarcus Aldridge on his surprise that Manu Ginobili needed surgery:

“I thought he just would go home & put some ice on it & be on the road trip.”

LaMarcus Aldridge on Manu Ginobili, Feb 5, 2016. Source: Twitter.
